name: toggle-38
description: A chat message with a translate toggle that swaps between original and translated text.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { LanguagesIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@workspace/ui/components/avatar" import { Toggle } from "@workspace/ui/components/toggle" export default function MessageTranslateToggle() { const [translated, setTranslated] = React.useState(false) return (
LM
{translated ? "Can we move the call to Thursday morning?" : "On peut décaler l'appel à jeudi matin ?"}
Louis Martin - 10:42 {translated ? "Show original" : "Translate"}
) }
